in_marathi.name: Dheerandra
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dheerandra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dheerandra is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘dheera’ meaning fearless and ‘andra’ meaning man. This name is attributed to several mythological figures in Hinduism, who displayed immense courage and bravery.
